title: Supported constructible etale origin and its unbounded coefficient tensor comparison
statement:
Let $A\to B$ be a unital homomorphism of finite commutative rings, let $U,Z$ be schemes, and let $j:U\hookrightarrow Z$ be an open immersion. Use constant-ring module sheaves on the small etale and pro-etale sites and their ordinary uncompleted unbounded derived categories, with exact comparison $\nu_T^*$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules, def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], and the extensions $j_!^{\mathrm{et},A}$ and $j_!^{\mathrm{pro},A}$ [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero, def-weil-extension-by-zero]. Let $M\in D(U_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ have bounded intrinsically constructible cohomology [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf]. Then there exist a bounded etale $A$-complex $L$ with constructible cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] and an isomorphism $e:\nu_U^*L\xrightarrow{\sim}M$. For every such pair $(L,e)$ put
$$K=j_!^{\mathrm{et},A}L,\qquad N=j_!^{\mathrm{pro},A}M,\qquad H=K\otimes^L_{A_{Z,\mathrm{et}}}B_{Z,\mathrm{et}},$$
where $B$ is regarded as an $A$-module [def-kun-derived-tensor]. The complexes $K$ and $N$ are bounded. The termwise sheaf comparison, composed with $j_!^{\mathrm{pro},A}(e)$, induces a canonical isomorphism
$$c_e:\nu_Z^*K\xrightarrow{\sim}N.$$
There is also a canonical isomorphism in the unbounded derived category
$$t_e:\nu_Z^*H\xrightarrow{\sim}N\otimes^L_{A_Z}B_Z,$$
where the target is the pro-etale derived tensor [def-weil-derived-tensor].
Here $t_e$ is the composite of the derived tensor pullback comparison, the constant-section-preserving identification $\nu_Z^*B_{Z,\mathrm{et}}\cong B_Z$ as $A_Z$-modules, and $c_e\otimes1$. No finite Tor-amplitude hypothesis on $M$ or $B$ is imposed, and no boundedness of $H$ is asserted.

proof.text: On every stratum of each cohomology sheaf apply [lem-sf-proetale-lisse-finite-models] to its local constancy and finite geometric stalks. The same stratification now witnesses source-library fixed-module constructibility. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-fixed-module-constructible-origin] degreewise, then [lem-weil-pbc-fixed-module-bounded-constructible-origin] to hM and those sheaf origins. This supplies a bounded constructible etale L and an isomorphism of its comparison image with M. Convert the cohomology predicates using [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-etale-module-sheaf-comparison]. This avoids transporting to intrinsic ringed coefficients or changing the coefficient universe.

proof.text: For every chosen L, exact fixed-module extension by zero on the etale and pro-etale sites preserves boundedness by CategoryTheory.Functor.bounded_mapDerivedCategory_obj. Apply this directly to hL and hM; constructibility and the origin isomorphism are unnecessary for these two bounds. The fixed-module exactness instances are the ones underlying [lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-exact] and [lem-weil-extension-by-zero-exact]. The existing openComparison definition applies Functor.mapDerivedCategorySquareIso to the canonical sheaf comparison [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison] and composes with pro-etale j_! applied to e. Thus it supplies precisely the required c_e for every origin.

proof.text: The constantModuleComparison definition reuses comparisonUpperStarConstantSheafIso, whose body is the same left-adjoint uniqueness construction from the constant-sheaf adjunction [lem-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf-maps-global-sections] and the site-comparison adjunction [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. The inclusion fixes the terminal scheme, so the two right adjoints are identified by evaluation on that terminal object. Its adjunction hom equivalences send pulled-back constant sections to themselves. Apply mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor and then the degree-zero single functor to this natural isomorphism at B restricted along A to B. This is coefficientComparison: an A-linear comparison with the prescribed constant-section normalization.

source.place: Tag 0H7J, example-constant-sheaf; universal-property calculation for the site inclusion

proof.text: The existing canonical fixed-module comparison derivedTensorObjCompMapDerivedCategoryComparisonUpperStarIso constructs the unbounded tensor pullback isomorphism from the strong monoidal exact comparison via Functor.leftDerivedTensorComparison. The coefficient categories and derived tensors are [def-kun-derived-tensor] and [def-weil-derived-tensor]; exactness is [prop-weil-pbc-site-comparison-finite-level]. The existing tensorComparison definition composes this isomorphism with the image of coefficientComparison under tensor with nu_Z^*K and then the tensor image of openComparison. This is exactly the prescribed order: tensor pullback, 1 tensor beta_B, c_e tensor 1. Each factor is an isomorphism in the unbounded derived category; no Tor bound or bound on H is used. No general ringed-topos coefficient transport is needed.
